subject: english
prompt: 提示：Look! / the children / build / a paper bridge / now. Choose the sentence that describes the action in progress.

options.text: The children are building a paper bridge now.
The children is building a paper bridge now.
The children building are a paper bridge now.
The children build a paper bridge now.

answer.explanation: Look! and now point to an action happening at this moment. The plural subject children takes are, followed by the -ing form building.

solutionStrategy: 看到 Look!／now，先判斷此刻正在發生，再用 be＋V-ing；be 動詞依複數主詞選 are。
solutionSteps: 從 Look! 和 now 找到「正在發生」的時間訊號。
把動作 build 改成 building。
確認 children 是複數，搭配 are。
選 A；B 主詞與 be 不一致，C 詞序錯，D 沒有表現進行中的形式。
